sentences.en: Some people say that the judicial system is rigged.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为司法系统存在偏见。

sentences.en: The dictator arrogated judicial powers to himself.
sentences.zh: 独裁者将司法权力据为己有。

sentences.en: The new law guarantees the same judicial and social rights to homosexual couples.
sentences.zh: 新法律保证同性伴侣享有相同的司法和社会权利。

senses.zh: 司法的, 法庭的, 审判的 - 明断的, 公正的
